stories.title: Kallas: "Prepariamoci a possibili attacchi da Mosca". Drone viola lo spazio aereo lituano

en.title: Kallas: "Let's prepare for possible attacks from Moscow". Drone violates Lithuanian airspace
en.summary: EU leadership warns of potential Russian attacks while a drone breaches Lithuanian airspace. Infrastructure in Ukraine faces strikes, and Russia is reported to be significantly increasing military spending.

stories.title: Sinner ancora ai box salta anche il Masters 1000 di Shanghai

en.title: Sinner still sidelined, skips Shanghai Masters 1000 as well
en.summary: World number one tennis player Sinner remains absent from competition due to knee issues and suboptimal physical condition. He has not played a match in nearly three months.

stories.title: Sinner, slitta ancora il rientro: salta anche il Masters 1000 di Shanghai

en.title: Sinner, return delayed again: skips Shanghai Masters 1000 as well
en.summary: The world's top-ranked tennis player extends his absence from competition, with no matches played in almost three months.

stories.title: In Siberia donna morta di peste: 200 persone in quarantena. Possibile contagio in laboratorio

en.title: Woman dies of plague in Siberia: 200 people quarantined. Possible laboratory contagion
en.summary: A laboratory technician in Siberia died from plague with 200 contacts quarantined. Local reports suggest she may have been infected through a broken test tube in the lab.

stories.title: Procuratore Emirati, 'copilota del volo FlyDubai pianificava un atto terroristico'

en.title: UAE Prosecutor: FlyDubai Flight Copilot Was Planning a Terrorist Act
en.summary: An Emirates prosecutor states that a copilot on a FlyDubai flight attacked the captain with an emergency axe and attempted to seize control of the aircraft.

stories.title: Diretta qualifiche F1, Verstappen in pole a Sepang davanti a Hamilton. Seconda fila per Antonelli

en.title: F1 Qualifying Live: Verstappen Takes Pole at Sepang Ahead of Hamilton. Antonelli in Second Row
en.summary: Red Bull's Verstappen secured pole position at the Malaysian Grand Prix qualifying session, with Hamilton's Ferrari following in second and Antonelli qualifying for the second row.

stories.title: Drone viola lo spazio aereo lituano, allerta alla popolazione

en.title: Drone Violates Lithuanian Airspace, Population Alert Issued
en.summary: A drone breach of Lithuanian airspace triggered a civil alert instructing residents to identify and prepare to access nearby air raid shelters if necessary.

stories.title: Sinner salta anche Shanghai, il problema al ginocchio non è ancora risolto

en.title: Sinner Withdraws from Shanghai, Knee Problem Remains Unresolved
en.summary: The world's top-ranked player is skipping the Shanghai Masters following his withdrawal from the China Open, sitting out the entire Asian tour with a potential return planned for Vienna on October 24.

stories.title: Dirottamento del volo Flydubai, gli Emirati confermano: “Attacco terroristico”

en.title: Flydubai Flight Hijacking, UAE Confirms: "Terrorist Attack"
en.summary: The UAE confirmed that a Flydubai flight diversion constituted a terrorist attack. The first flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv has resumed after the incident.

stories.title: Guerra Ucraina - Russia. Drone viola lo spazio aereo lituano. Colpito un altro ponte a Kiev

en.title: Ukraine-Russia War: Drone Violates Lithuanian Airspace; Another Bridge Hit in Kyiv
en.summary: A drone violated Lithuanian airspace while Russia launched new attacks on Kyiv, damaging a bridge and infrastructure. Thousands of residents are fleeing the capital.

stories.title: Drone viola lo spazio aereo lituano, decollati i caccia della Nato: allarme rientrato dopo un’ora

en.title: Drone Violates Lithuanian Airspace, NATO Fighter Jets Deployed: Alert Ended After One Hour
en.summary: NATO fighter jets responded to a drone entering Lithuanian airspace, with the alert resolved within an hour. Russia simultaneously attacked Kyiv infrastructure as Moscow reportedly prepares intensified winter operations.

stories.title: Flydubai, identificato copilota: il 29enne al-Hammami. Emirati confermano “attacco terroristico”

en.title: Flydubai, Copilot Identified: 29-year-old al-Hammami; UAE Confirms "Terrorist Attack"
en.summary: The copilot of the Flydubai incident has been identified as the 29-year-old al-Hammami. The Indian captain, hospitalized in the UAE, described efforts to regain control during the attack.

stories.title: Bilancio UE: 17 paesi contro nuovi tagli a Coesione e Agricoltura

en.title: EU Budget: 17 countries oppose new cuts to Cohesion and Agriculture
en.summary: Seventeen EU member states have sent a letter to European leadership ahead of an October 15-16 council meeting to express opposition to proposed reductions in cohesion and agricultural funding within the 2024-2034 budget framework.

stories.title: Puglia, debutta l’aero cargo Taranto Grottaglie per l’agroalimentare del Sud

en.title: Puglia launches cargo air service from Taranto Grottaglie for Southern agricultural products
en.summary: A new cargo airline service has begun operating in Puglia in collaboration with Turkish Airlines, transporting agricultural goods through Istanbul for distribution worldwide.

stories.title: Porti turistici, giro d’affari previsto in crescita nel 2027

en.title: Tourist ports forecast business growth in 2027
en.summary: Mooring services are expected to continue experiencing positive performance next year following current strong results, with favorable prospects anticipated for the coming five-year period.

stories.title: Serco lancia la piattaforma per elaborare dati satellitari per Pa e imprese

en.title: Serco launches platform for processing satellite data for public administration and businesses
en.summary: Serco has introduced NadirEO, a platform that converts Earth observation data into ready-to-use analysis for companies and government agencies, unveiled at the inaugural Bex-Beyond Exploration Expo.

stories.title: Spazio, dalle tute ai materiali: +113% nei brevetti per le Pmi

en.title: Space, from spacesuits to materials: +113% in patents for SMEs
en.summary: Small and medium enterprises are increasing patents in the space economy sector, with growth spanning from aerospace apparel to satellite technology, building on expertise from traditional manufacturing, textiles, and automotive industries.
